snippet.title: Bee Simulator: The Hive | Console Release Date Trailer (PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch)
snippet.description:
🐝💛 The bees... They're everywhere! Bee Simulator: The Hive is coming to all consoles on November 28! 💛🐝

PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013420
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/bee-simulator-the-hive/9NQJQ0Q58CKD
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/bee-simulator-the-hive-switch/

🌻 Grab that controller and see the world through the eyes of a honeybee, collect pollen, race, brawl, dance, and learn about many plants and animals! 🦋 

🍯 Explore the Central Park-inspired world and zap through other maps, now more beautiful than ever. Discover new mechanics and build a hive your colony that you always dreamed of, the way YOU like it.

#bees  #beekeeping  #cozygaming  #indiegame
